## Validation Harness

This validation was performed using the static analysis harness located at:
`tests/validation-harnesses/activity-template-flow-via-mcp-backend-harness.ts`

The harness validates:
1. MCP connection status (test_metabob_mcp tool exists)
2. TemplateLoader returns source='metabob' for backend templates
3. No active direct file access to .metabob/activities
4. MetabobCLI has no local template writes (lines 803-813 commented)
5. Activity agent has search_activities, no impulse tools
6. Memory agent has impulse tools and activity tools
7. TemplateServiceClient delegates to MetabobCLI
